li.label: sacred oath fulfilled
li.description: We kept an oath sworn before the gods. The old gods remember our honor.

li.label: sacred oath broken
li.description: We failed an oath sworn before the gods. Their carved faces witnessed our dishonor.

li.label: prepared for winter
li.description: Winter came, but we stored at least ten days of food for each colonist. We prepared together, and we will endure together.

li.label: unprepared for winter
li.description: Winter is here and our food reserves have fallen below three days per colonist. Hunger waits beyond the cold.

li.label: beautiful snow
li.description: Snow has blanketed the land in austere, silent beauty.

li.label: dishonorable intrigue
li.description: Our House ordered secret intrigues instead of meeting its rivals openly. Whatever the gain, our honor is stained.
